name: bench-003-nema17-2020-adapter-plate-v1
summary: Flat NEMA17-to-2020 adapter plate: motor 31mm bolt square + shaft bore on +Z face, 2x M5 T-nut clearance through the plate to the extrusion slot below, 4mm plate, PLA, prints flat without supports.

dimensions.spec: 2x M5 clearance (5.2mm), spaced for the 2020 slot
from vertical, printable flat-on-build-plate without support

required_interfaces.must_present: 4x M3 in 31mm square + central shaft bore, +Z face
2x M5 clearance spaced ~20mm for T-nuts, drilled through the plate (-Z face)

hard_constraints: single flat plate (no upright, no gusset, no walls)
printable flat on FDM without supports (overhangs <= 45 deg)
motor face bolts and T-nut bolts each keep >= min_wall land to the nearest plate edge
